title: Projectile time correct
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the free-fall time using h = (1/2)gt², yielding t = 0.30 s.

title: Post-collision velocity correct
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the combined velocity after collision using s = v*t, yielding v = 1.0 m/s.

title: Conservation of momentum applied
description: Important: Student applies momentum conservation for the inelastic collision: m*v0 = (2m)*v.

title: Initial velocity correct
description: Essential: Student correctly solves for v0 from momentum conservation, yielding v0 = 2.0 m/s.

title: Energy loss calculation
description: Important: Student calculates the mechanical energy loss as ΔE = (1/2)m*v0² - (1/2)(2m)*v².

title: Energy loss value correct
description: Essential: Student correctly computes the numerical value of ΔE, yielding 0.10 J.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student shows consistent use of SI units (m, s, m/s, J) throughout the solution.

title: Sign error in energy
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly writes ΔE as final energy minus initial energy, giving a negative loss.

title: Forgetting combined mass
description: Pitfall: Student uses mass m instead of 2m in the post-collision momentum or kinetic energy expressions.
